subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-12 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), second of two on book p84, paired with v2-p84-1. Continues the transfer-cycles argument: 'it is important to view the many culture groups which have been on the planet as a means to understand the route of a given information thrust.' (C)C-INFO (the concept of composite information) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what composite-information produces when crossed with progressional-continuance — given that 'every cultural group has, on one level or another, utilized some (or every) aspect of principle information.' (R)TH-CONT (the reality of theoretical continuance) sits between subject and partner. SOC-RT (social reality) anchors the upper-right output. PROG-CONT itself is the central crossing axis. (C)MT-INFO (the concept of multi-information) hangs on the right margin. EXT-F (extended functionalism) feeds in from the lower-left. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) anchors the lower-left. CULT-INFO-DY (culture-information dynamics) sits below the crossing line. AFD (affinity-determinative) and (R)INT (reality interior) form the lower-center. BIA (bias) hangs on the right output. (R)PART (the reality of participation) anchors the lower-right margin. Structural argument: composite-information crossed with progressional-continuance is mediated through the reality-of-theoretical-continuance as central hub. The multiple (c) and (r) prefixes distributed across the nodes registers Braxton's careful distinction between *concept-of* and *reality-of* — composite-information is taken conceptually (we are still analyzing the design), but theoretical-continuance and participation are taken in their realized forms (these must actually obtain for transfer-cycles to read truly). The diagram exposes that culture-information-dynamics is fed *upward* from affinity-determinative plus reality-interior, but flows *outward* to bias — a structural diagnostic of how composite-information becomes filtered into culture-bias through the very same hub that should produce progressional-continuance.
